changelog:
Initial release of Auto Researcher – an AI-powered cross-platform research assistant.

- Automatically researches any topic across X/Twitter, Reddit, YouTube, GitHub, Hacker News, Product Hunt, and news sites.
- Generates structured insight reports including market trends, competitor analysis, technical research, and user feedback summaries.
- Provides command-line tools and scripts for rapid or in-depth research and report generation.
- Supports multiple output formats (Markdown, JSON, slides) and customizable report templates.
- Offers free, paid, and enterprise tiers for different user needs.
summary: AI 研究助手 - 自动跨平台研究任何主题并生成结构化报告。 支持平台：X/Twitter、Reddit、YouTube、GitHub、Hacker News、Product Hunt、新闻网站。 触发词："研究"、"调研"、"分析"、"收集信息"、"auto research"、"research this"。...
